title: Evaluating the significance of histopathological studies of the ligamenta flava / posterior longitudinal ligament in patients with lumbar, thoracic and cervical spinal stenosis for early detection and screening of systemic amyloidosis
summary: Intraoperatively removed ligament flava / posterior longitudinal ligament in patients with degenerative spinal stenosis is to be analyzed for proteins that could hint at a metabolic cause

interventions.name: All patients with a degenerative cervical, thoracic or lumbar spinal stenosis that are operatively treated at the University Hospital Cologne within one year are candidates to be included in this prospective study.
